sections.title: About UWEC
sections.body: Universal Website Constructor is a modular demo catalog. Each page showcases one feature — layouts, CMS snippets, maps, media, admin tools — as a standalone static HTML file.

sections.title: How demos persist data
sections.body: Seed content lives in assets/data/*.json. When you edit checklists, comments, trips, or blog posts, changes save to localStorage in your browser only — nothing is sent to a server.

sections.title: Admin demo
sections.body: Click Login as Demo Admin in the footer. This unlocks add buttons and the admin panel preview. There is no real authentication; it simulates an logged-in admin session for UI testing.

sections.title: Extending modules
sections.body: Copy a demo HTML page, add JSON seed data, and wire a render function in assets/js/demo-data.js. Keep pages flat so the landing index remains the single entry point.
